title: A cooperative's outages, restored in steps
heading: SAIFI Counts Interruptions and SAIDI Counts Minutes, per Customer Served
cases: an outage restored in two steps counts each group of customers for the minutes it waited
a year of several staged outages gives the indices worked out by hand
customers restored within five minutes of an outage that lasted longer for others are left out
customers restored at exactly five minutes are left out
CAIDI averages the wait over every interrupted customer, not over outages, and is 0 in a year of blinks
